verdict.rationale: An in-app AI assistant that learns a user's tone, shorthand, and preferences is a fair question for a project-planning tool, so the axis applies. The only AI-related evidence is that users can assign an issue to Copilot to delegate work, which is about task delegation, not personalization. Saved views and custom fields are user-configured settings, not AI learning, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have my in-app AI assistant learn my tone, shorthand, and preferences to tailor its output
